segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report that the cleanser controls oiliness, cleans deeply, and helps with acne without leaving skin greasy, though one notes it does not change underlying oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it does not dry or tighten their skin and even leaves it soft, while others (including one with dry skin who tested only on hands) report stinging, dryness, or irritation.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report a balanced, non-greasy feel and fewer breakouts, though one combination-skin reviewer found the product too strong and returned it.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many say it is gentle, fragrance-free, and non-irritating even with acids, but some report stinging, warmth, itching, or that it felt too strong and had to be discontinued.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin report mixed results, from no issues and good exfoliation to dryness, shine, and small breakouts from over-exfoliation with daily use.
segments.mature: The few reviewers identifying as having mature or aging skin report clearer skin and reduced hormonal breakouts without dryness, though one older reviewer found the formula unsuitable and stinging.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging/mature skin report clearer skin and fewer hormonal breakouts without drying effects; one older reviewer found the product not formulated for her skin and experienced stinging.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or tighten skin and even leaves it soft or hydrated; however, several others report significant dryness, tightness, or flaking, especially with twice-daily use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers explicitly note no redness or irritation after use, but a few sensitive-skin reviewers describe warmth, stinging, or burning on contact.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the cleanser with helping protect her skin barrier while reducing acne and redness; no other barrier-specific comments are reported.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fewer new blemishes, faster fading of acne scars, and clearer pores with regular use; one reviewer says it burned her skin when acne was sun-exposed and did nothing to help.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report visibly reduced breakouts, smaller pores, and calmer skin over time, though one reviewer experienced initial purging and another saw no change in her occasional breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers frequently report reduced shine and better oil control through the day; one reviewer notes the product cleans well but does not change her skin's inherent oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Too strong or stinging for daily use

extraits.texte: I received a sample of this cleanser and thought I would give it a try. I have normal skin, generally not too oily or too dry. I used this cleanser twice a day for a couple of weeks and it left my skin very dry and shiny, with little breakouts all over my forehead - clear signs of over-exfoliation. It was the only thing that I changed in my routine, so I am confident the cleanser was the culprit. I would not recommend this for use regularly.

extraits.titre: Test for Sensitivity Before Applying to Face
extraits.texte: The cleanser is clear and transforms into a white lather. I used this on my hands and while waiting for the pictures to be taken, my hands felt slightly warm and itchy. I have very sensitive skin and because of how my hands were reacting, I unfortunately wasn't able to use it on my face. My hands felt a little softer after rinsing. I would recommend this product, but test on hands or something before application to face, in case of possible sensitivities.

extraits.titre: Too strong to be used as directed
extraits.texte: Definetly great for getting impurities off your face, but personally way too harsh for daily use. You'll need an intense moisturizer and serum to accompany this cleanser. I practically dried my skin to smithereens using it as directed. Using a gentler cleanser daily and this one once every other evening seems to be the spot for me. Sensitive skin types should be wary.

extraits.titre: Will be buying again and again
extraits.texte: I am 21 years old and have had acne since I was 12. It has come and gone throughout various points in my life, and shown up in different ways/different types of acne. As an adult, I started getting a lot of acne on my cheeks and jaw. This is the ONLY thing that cleared it. I tried cerave sa cleanser, I'd tried benzoyl peroxide cleansers, and nothing worked (even though it USED to work for me). This has helped clear acne scars and reduce new acne, protect my skin barrier, and give a more even tone to my face (no redness). now, I still get acne here and there, but for the most part it is gone. I have oily/combination skin. I HIGHLY recommend this product. Yes it's expensive, and yes it's worth it.

extraits.titre: Great for sensitive skin. Non-drying but clarifying
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Finally a gentle non stripping yet clarifying cleanser!!! I was hesitant at first because most salicylic acid or clarifying cleansers are severely drying on the skin but the Exuviance 3-in-1 was opposite of that. My skin felt supple and soft after cleansing. It do not feel stripped down but it did feel as it removed all the impurities from the day. I am very impressed and happy with this product. This coming from someone who lives in chicago cold winters with dry skin! It did not leave my skin tight after washing. There was no harsh scent, in fact I did not notice a strong scent. The size of this cleanser is big. I used a dime sized amount. I can see this lasting a while. Great product for those who need a clarifying salicylic cleanser.

I have acne prone sensitive skin, combination oily on the t-zone & dry on the cheeks. This cleanser did not disappoint! It's gentle, fragrance free, and does a great job cleansing. My face felt squeaky clean and not overly dry or uncomfortable after. I love that it has 3 types of exfoliants bha, aha, & pha! It did not burn of sting my skin even though there were 3 types of exfoliants. Highly recommend this product and can't wait to see my complexion get even better with prolonged use!

I've been using this cleanser on my aging skin that has been prone to hormonal breakouts for the last 3 weeks. My skin is clearer than it's new in awhile and it hasn't dried out my skin either. It's great at removing my makeup also. Smell is mild and pleasant. I received this product to review but this is my honest opinion.
